SAMPLE COMPANY COMPLIANCE DOCUMENT

This document outlines our compliance framework for the current financial year.

ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING
We conducted our Annual General Meeting on 15th September 2024, within the prescribed timeframe as per Section 96 of the Companies Act, 2013. The AGM was properly noticed and all required resolutions were passed.

FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FILING
Our audited financial statements for FY 2023-24 have been prepared and we are planning to file Form AOC-4 with the MCA within the required timeline of 30 days from the AGM date as mandated by Section 137 of the Companies Act, 2013.

ANNUAL RETURN
The company's annual return in Form MGT-7 needs to be filed within 60 days of the AGM as per Section 92 and Rule 11 of the Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014.

DIRECTOR KYC
All our directors have updated their DIR-3 KYC before the 30th September deadline as required under Rule 12A of the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014.

AUDITOR APPOINTMENT
We ratified the appointment of our statutory auditor in the recent AGM and need to file Form ADT-1 within 15 days as per Section 139 and Rule 4 of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014.

DEPOSITS RETURN
The company has not accepted any deposits during the financial year, but we still need to file Form DPT-3 by 30th June as required under Rule 16 of the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

MSME COMPLIANCE
We have outstanding payments to some micro and small enterprise suppliers. We need to prepare the MSME-1 return for the half-yearly period ending March 2024, due by 30th April.

CSR ACTIVITIES
As our company falls under the CSR applicability thresholds under Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013, we need to ensure proper CSR spend and reporting through the CSR committee.
